services.title: Driveway Repairs & Maintenance

services.title: Garden Landscaping & Design
services.desc: Integrated landscaping with pathways, borders, and planted areas. We work with you to create a garden that's beautiful and functional year-round.

services.title: Gravel & Decorative Surfacing

about_pullquote: Every garden deserves quality paving that lasts. We build it right, first time.
about_para_1: Bespoke Lawns & Driveways has been serving Liverpool and Merseyside for over 12 years. We started because we were frustrated seeing poor-quality driveways and garden work across the city — soft sub-bases, rushed jobs, and cowboys taking the money. We built this business on doing it properly: solid foundations, attention to detail, and guarantees that mean something.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen before we design, quote fairly, and finish on time. We specialise in residential driveways and garden transformation, but we've also earned a strong reputation with property developers and estate managers across the North West. Whether it's a modest patio or a full garden rebuild, we approach every job with the same care.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our driveway. Paul came out for the survey, explained everything clearly, and gave us a realistic price. The lads worked hard and left the site spotless. Looks fantastic and we've had loads of compliments from the neighbours. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with cracks appearing in our old tarmac. Bespoke Lawns sorted it — replaced the whole thing in paving and it's transformed the front of the house. Professional team, no messing about, and they finished a day early. Really happy with the result.
reviews.author: Jennifer W.

reviews.text: We wanted a patio and garden overhaul but weren't sure what was possible with our space. The lads listened to what we wanted and came back with a design that works perfectly. Quality materials, tidy throughout, and genuinely good value. Top marks.
reviews.author: David P.
